usageNotes: Use this endpoint to extract and download a specific file or directory from a PBS backup snapshot without fully restoring the VM or container. The `filepath` parameter must be base64-encoded; pass `tar=true` to receive directories as a `.tar.zst` archive instead of the default `.zip`. Only PBS-backed storage volumes are supported — backups on other storage types will be rejected.

examples.summary: Download a single config file from a PBS VM backup as a zip

tips: Base64-encode the full absolute path (e.g. /etc/nginx/nginx.conf) before passing it as `filepath`.
Set `tar=true` when downloading a directory — zip output for large directories can be slower to stream.
The response streams binary archive data directly; pipe or save it immediately rather than buffering the full body in memory.
Requires the calling user or API token to have Datastore.Read (or equivalent) on the PBS storage — verify permissions on the PBS side, not just the PVE side.
